concerns.text: The plan states: “Compute absolute errors for Model A vs. Model B on the full test set (including proxy rows).” However, Feature Set B (Model B) is defined to contain only rows where `is_proxy=False` (i.e., measured residual stress). Consequently, Model B will not produce predictions for proxy rows, making a paired‑sample comparison impossible for those observations. Including proxy rows in the paired t‑test mixes unequal sample sets and introduces bias, violating the requirement that the validation target (error difference) be computed on the same set of predictions. The methodology should restrict the paired t‑test to the intersection of rows where both models have predictions (measured‑stress subset) or otherwise handle missing predictions appropriately.
